title: Default Slot an Hour Out
description: Dispatchers shouldn't have to think about the clock every time they open the board — the slot-start field defaults to something schedulable right away: an hour from now, not the current instant.
successCondition: On first loading /fleet, the "Slot start (2-hour window)" datetime-local input's default value is within a few minutes of exactly one hour after the page loaded (not the current time, and not some fixed placeholder date).
hints: defaultDateTimeLocal() in FleetPage.tsx computes Date.now() + 1 hour, seconds/millis zeroed — allow a small tolerance window for time elapsed during page load.
Parse the input's value as a local datetime and compare it against your test's own "now + 1h" rather than a hardcoded timestamp.
